agent_final_message:
Pelican now builds the same content, settings and plugins to the same output every time. The static-file manifest from your repro is identical across builds with different `PYTHONHASHSEED` values (I tried 1, 2 and 3).

**Cause:** `get_files()` returns a `set`, and the generators looped over it directly. The static generator looped over `linked_files | found_files`, another set. String hashing is randomized per process, so the order in which plugins saw static files varied from run to run. The order of articles and pages also depended on those sets. That could change which of two same-date items came first.

**Fix:** in `pelican/generators.py` I now wrap the article, page and static-file loops in `sorted(...)`. It doesn't touch `get_files()`'s return type or any plugin or theme API, and it doesn't read environment variables. It works the same from the `pelican` command or as a library. I didn't check whether sites that are already reproducible keep byte-identical output; the one thing changed is the order files are processed in.

**Tests:** `python -m pytest pelican/tests -n 4` gives 291 passed, 21 skipped and 1 error. The error is an import failure in `pelican/tests/build_test/test_build_files.py`. It also fails the same way with my change stashed, so it isn't caused by this fix. I haven't looked into why it fails to import.

**Running your repro:** the steps in `bug-repro/README.md` don't load the plugin as written. `PLUGIN_PATHS=["bug-repro"]` is relative, so Pelican logs `Cannot load plugin static_manifest` and no manifest is written. With an absolute path (`/work/repo/bug-repro`) it loads. I didn't edit the README.
